title: Cohort Safety Signal Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A six-card sorting quiz in which learners classify moments from a live cohort session as Safety-Building or Safety-Eroding, with immediate green or amber feedback and a one-sentence explanation for each card.

prerequisites: Chapter 2: Founder Mindset & the Cohort Learning Experience
educational.topic: Psychological safety in a peer cohort
learningObjectives: Classify moments from a cohort session as Safety-Building or Safety-Eroding by applying the chapter's definition of psychological safety

controls.label: Safety-Building
controls.purpose: Classify the current moment as one that makes honest sharing more likely

controls.label: Safety-Eroding
controls.purpose: Classify the current moment as one that makes honest sharing less likely

controls.label: Try Again
controls.purpose: Reshuffle the cards and start over

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classification quiz with immediate corrective feedback
keyQuestions: How did the room respond to what was shared?
Does this moment make the next honest share more likely, or less likely?
commonMisconceptions: Safety only erodes when someone says something harsh out loud
A quiet participant means nothing is wrong
assessmentOpportunities: Score at least 5 of 6 on a second, shuffled attempt
Rewrite a Safety-Eroding moment as a Safety-Building response
